Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. Bounded continuous real tests and explicit4M² domination are ASTIS elaborations of source compactly supported continuous tests; no all-L2 or main-theorem credit.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. In addition, define the exact conditional position probability q_y=volume.tilted(x↦−V(x)−‖x−y‖²/(2η)) and the initial phase probability ν_y=q_y⊗N(0,I_E). Both probability normalizations are conclusions derived from the same six analytic hypotheses. For each fixed y,xRef, each continuous real f:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 with |f(z)|≤M for all z, define the actual clock expectation A_t f(z)=∫_Ω f(Z(y,xRef,z,t,sample))P(dsample). For every finite t≥0, A_t f is Borel measurable in z; z↦(A_t f(z)−f(z))² is ν_y-integrable and obeys the pointwise bound (A_t f(z)−f(z))²≤4M² for every phase z. Moreover ∫(A_t f(z)−f(z))²ν_y(dz)→0 as t→0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter on nonnegative reals. The same single existential actual phase Z is used for every test, bound and initial state. These outputs hold for every deterministic y and xRef without any phase-invariance premise. This is the bounded continuous real test subclass, an attributed ASTIS extension of the authors compactly supported continuous test ingredient in AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. It is not the general L² equivalence-class operator theorem. Full invariant-law and AE-representative semantics, contraction/Jensen, C_c density and extension to every L² test, restart/Markov/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/unbounded cost, actual-input composition and full main results remain separate OPEN obligations.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n : ℕ, eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) ∧
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧
          ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) ∧
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        Z y xRef z₀ 0 sample = z₀)
 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
          MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ∧
          P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ≤
              1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) ∧
        (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0, MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)))

 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        ∀ f : (E × E) → ℝ, Continuous f →
        ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ z : E × E, |f z| ≤ M) →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
            Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) ∧
            Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P ∧
            |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) -
                f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
              2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P)
            (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)))


 ∧
      (let q : E → Measure E := fun y =>
         (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))
       let ν : E → Measure (E × E) := fun y => (q y).prod (stdGaussian E)
       (∀ y : E, IsProbabilityMeasure (q y) ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (ν y)) ∧
       (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ f : (E × E) → ℝ, Continuous f →
         ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ z : E × E, |f z| ≤ M) →
           let A : ℝ≥0 → (E × E) → ℝ := fun t z₀ =>
             ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P
           (∀ t : ℝ≥0, Measurable (A t) ∧
             Integrable (fun z₀ : E × E => (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2) (ν y) ∧
             (∀ z₀ : E × E, (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * M ^ 2)) ∧
           Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 =>
             ∫ z₀, (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2 ∂(ν y)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)))

Anonymous theorem reconstruction

Fix a finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, with its normed additive group structure and its Borel measurable structure. Dimension zero is permitted. Fix V : E -> R, nonnegative real parameters alpha and beta, and eta : R. The only supplied mathematical hypotheses are:
(1) alpha > 0;
(2) alpha <= beta;
(3) V is twice continuously differentiable;
(4) for every x,v in E,
    alpha * ||v||^2 <= D(DV)(x)[v][v] <= beta * ||v||^2;
(5) eta > 0;
(6) beta * eta <= 1.
Here alpha and beta in real formulas mean their coercions from NNReal to R. D denotes the real Frechet derivative, and grad V is the real inner-product gradient. No measurable path, nonexplosion, normalizer positivity, or probability-kernel premise is supplied.

Define the following objects literally. The clock sample space is Omega = R^N, equipped with the canonical countable product measurable structure and the probability P = product over k in N of Exp(1), where Exp(1) is the rate-one exponential measure on R. For every sample omega, including exceptional samples outside the support of P, let e_k(omega) = max(omega_k,0), regarded as an NNReal.

For y,r in E define c(y,r) = y - eta * grad V(r). For z=(x,v) in E x E and real s, put
    Phi(y,r,s,(x,v)) =
      ( c(y,r) + cos(s)*(x-c(y,r)) + sqrt(eta)*sin(s)*v,
        (-sin(s)/sqrt(eta))*(x-c(y,r)) + cos(s)*v ).
Scalar products with vectors here are real scalar multiplication. Write g_r(x) = grad V(x) - grad V(r). Define
    S(r,(x,v)) = ( x, v - (2*<v,g_r(x)> / ||g_r(x)||^2)*g_r(x) ),
    rate(r,(x,v)) = sqrt(eta) * max(0,<v,g_r(x)>).
These are total literal Lean functions: there is no supplied premise g_r(x) != 0. Division follows the total real-field convention, so the displayed S is defined also at a zero gradient difference.

For u in NNReal, define the cumulative rate
    Lambda(y,r,z,u) = integral from 0 to (u:R) of rate(r,Phi(y,r,s,z)) ds.
For e in NNReal define tau(y,r,z,e) in NNReal union {infinity} as the infimum of nonnegative times u for which Lambda(y,r,z,u)-e belongs to [0,infinity), equivalently Lambda(y,r,z,u) >= e, with infinity when the hit set is empty. This is precisely the supplied hittingAfter-at-zero convention; no alternative first strictly positive time is used.

The finite-record state space is (NNReal x (E x E)) disjoint union {stopped}. Given y,r,e, update a finite record (a,z) as follows. If tau(y,r,z,e)=infinity, return stopped. Otherwise return
    ( a+tau(y,r,z,e), S(r,Phi(y,r,(tau(y,r,z,e):R),z)) ).
The stopped record is absorbing. Finite values of tau in this expression are extracted by untopD 0 after the infinity guard. Initialize R_0(y,r,z0,e)=(0,z0) and recursively use e_k to produce R_{k+1} from R_k. Define T_n as the accumulated time of R_n when R_n is finite, and infinity when R_n is stopped. The stopped record carries no phase state at infinity. A finite-time trajectory may still follow the last finite record when its next time is infinity.

Conclusion: there exists a single total map
    Z : E -> E -> (E x E) -> NNReal -> Omega -> (E x E)
with all of the following properties. All clock records and times below use e=e(omega).

A. Joint measurability and total path convention.
The map (y,r,z0,t,omega) |-> Z(y,r,z0,t,omega) is measurable on the displayed product measurable spaces. For every y,r,z0, every sample omega, every t in NNReal, every n in N and every finite record (a,z), if
    T_n <= t < T_{n+1} and R_n=(a,z),
then
    Z(y,r,z0,t,omega) = Phi(y,r,((t-a):NNReal):R,z).
NNReal subtraction here is truncated at zero; on these time intervals the later almost-sure conclusion also states a<=t. Endpoint conventions are left closed and right open. For every y,r,z0,omega,t, if there is no n with T_n<=t<T_{n+1}, then
    Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)=z0.
Thus the existential witness has a specified value even for exceptional clock samples or times that lie in no such interval.

B. Almost-sure coverage at every nonnegative time and initialization.
For every fixed y,r,z0, for P-almost every omega, simultaneously for every t in NNReal, there exist n in N and a finite record (a,z) such that
    T_n <= t < T_{n+1},
    R_n=(a,z),
    a<=t,
    ((t-a):NNReal) < tau(y,r,z,e_n(omega)),
    Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)=Phi(y,r,((t-a):NNReal):R,z).
On the same almost-sure set,
    Z(y,r,z0,0,omega)=z0.
The exceptional null set may depend on y,r,z0. The time universal quantifier is inside the almost-sure assertion, so one such set works for all times for that fixed triple. This is a coverage and initialization conclusion, not a hypothesis on clock samples. In particular, the statement supplies finite record-index coverage for every finite nonnegative time almost surely.

C. A deviation probability bound and continuity in probability at zero.
For every y,r,z0 and every t in NNReal, the event
    B_t = {omega : Z(y,r,z0,t,omega) != Phi(y,r,(t:R),z0)}
is measurable and its real measure satisfies
    P.real(B_t) <= 1-exp(-Lambda(y,r,z0,t)).
For every real delta>0 the events
    C_{t,delta} = {omega : delta <= ||Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)-z0||}
are measurable for all t in NNReal, and
    lim_{t -> 0 in NNReal} P.real(C_{t,delta}) = 0.
The phase norm is the product norm appearing in Lean. The limit is the ordinary, nonpunctured neighborhood filter at zero within nonnegative times.

D. Bounded continuous test expectations.
For every y,r,z0, every continuous f : E x E -> R, and every real M>=0 satisfying |f(z)|<=M for every phase z, the random variable omega |-> f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) is measurable and Bochner integrable with respect to P for every t in NNReal. Its expectation obeys
    | integral f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) dP(omega)
        - f(Phi(y,r,(t:R),z0)) |
       <= 2*M*(1-exp(-Lambda(y,r,z0,t))).
Also
    lim_{t -> 0 in NNReal} integral f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) dP(omega)
       = f(z0).
Continuity and a global absolute bound are supplied only for the universally quantified test f; no derivative or compact-support premise on f is present. The same single Z works for every f and every admissible M.

E. Normalized phase law and squared expectation continuity.
For y in E let
    q_y = volume tilted by [x |-> -V(x)-||x-y||^2/(2*eta)],
where tilted means normalized exponential tilt, with its stipulated totalized zero convention if the normalizer vanishes. Let
    nu_y = q_y product stdGaussian(E),
where stdGaussian(E) is the identity-covariance standard Gaussian probability on E, and the product makes position and velocity independent. For every y, q_y and nu_y are probability measures. Probability normalization is an output, not a premise; no arbitrary reference density or unnormalized tilt replaces the displayed law. These measures depend on y,V,eta and not on the reference point r.

For every y,r, every continuous f : E x E -> R and every real M>=0 with |f(z)|<=M for all z, define the actual clock expectation, indexed by initial phase,
    A_t(z0) = integral f(Z(y,r,z0,t,omega)) dP(omega).
For every t in NNReal, A_t is measurable as a function of z0,
    z0 |-> (A_t(z0)-f(z0))^2
is Bochner integrable under nu_y, and, for every z0 without an almost-everywhere restriction,
    (A_t(z0)-f(z0))^2 <= 4*M^2.
Finally,
    lim_{t -> 0 in NNReal}
      integral (A_t(z0)-f(z0))^2 dnu_y(z0) = 0.
The inner expectation is under the actual exponential-clock product P; the outer integral is under the literal normalized tilted-position times Gaussian-velocity law. This asserts the displayed squared-integral convergence for bounded continuous tests. It does not quantify over all L2 functions or assert a semigroup law, invariance of nu_y, reversibility, uniqueness, an infinitesimal generator identity, or continuity at every positive time.

Quantifier and regularity summary.
After fixing E,V,alpha,beta,eta and the six analytic premises, the existential Z precedes every parameter choice y,r,z0, all times, all clock samples and every bounded continuous test. Joint measurability, almost-sure finite-index coverage, initialization, integrability, probability normalization, deviation estimates, and both expectation limits are conclusions. No randomness in y,r,z0 is assumed. All nonnegative times include zero; natural indices include zero. Totality applies on all of Omega, while the strongest time coverage is almost sure for each fixed initial/parameter triple. No dimension-dependent constant, extra derivative bound, externally supplied path, additional initial-law assumption, or hidden moment assumption occurs in the displayed proposition. The numeric constants in the displayed quantitative outputs are exactly 2 and 4, and the event-probability factor is exactly 1-exp(-Lambda).

    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : Prop :=
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n : ℕ, eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) ∧
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧

          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        Z y xRef z₀ 0 sample = z₀)
 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
          MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ∧
          P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ≤

        (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →

            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) ∧

 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        ∀ f : (E × E) → ℝ, Continuous f →
        ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ z : E × E, |f z| ≤ M) →

            Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) ∧
            Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P ∧
            |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) -
                f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
              2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P)
            (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)))


 ∧
      (let q : E → Measure E := fun y =>
         (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))
       let ν : E → Measure (E × E) := fun y => (q y).prod (stdGaussian E)
       (∀ y : E, IsProbabilityMeasure (q y) ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (ν y)) ∧

/-- For the actual PBPS phase, bounded continuous tests have a measurable clock expectation
whose squared difference from the initial test tends to zero under the exact conditional
Gibbs-times-Gaussian initial law. The C_b class is an explicit ASTIS extension of the source
C_c ingredient in arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1 Ex22; this is not the all-L2 operator result. -/
theorem actual_outer_bounded_l2_continuity
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_outer_bounded_l2_continuity_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let q : E → Measure E := fun y =>
    (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))
  let ν : E → Measure (E × E) := fun y => (q y).prod (stdGaussian E)
  obtain ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort, htest⟩ :=
    ActualBoundedTestContinuity.actual_bounded_test_expectation_continuity
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hZV := (GibbsAugmentation.normalized_augmentation_density
    hα hV (fun x v => (hH x v).1) hη).1
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : E => Real.exp (-V x)) (volume : Measure E) :=
    Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero hZV.ne'
  let μ : Measure E := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := isProbabilityMeasure_tilted hi
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRy, _⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianConditionalKernel.exists_tilted_isCondKernel μ hη
  letI : IsMarkovKernel R := hR
  have hRq (y : E) : R y = q y := by
    rw [hRy y, show μ = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x) from rfl,
      tilted_tilted hi]
    congr 1
    funext z
    dsimp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  have hqprob (y : E) : IsProbabilityMeasure (q y) := by
    rw [← hRq y]
    infer_instance
  have hνprob (y : E) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν y) := by
    letI := hqprob y
    dsimp only [ν]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  refine ⟨Z, hZM, hcovered, hfallback, hAE, hshort, htest, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun y => ⟨hqprob y, hνprob y⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y xRef f hf M hM hbound
  letI := hνprob y
  let A : ℝ≥0 → (E × E) → ℝ := fun t z₀ => ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P
  have hAM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (A t) := by
    have hargs : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        (((y, xRef), a.1), t, a.2)) :=
      (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_fst).prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)
    exact ((hf.measurable.comp (hZM.comp hargs)).stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right').measurable
  have hAbound (t : ℝ≥0) (z₀ : E × E) : |A t z₀| ≤ M := by
    have hb : ∀ᵐ sample ∂P, ‖f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)‖ ≤ M :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)
    simpa only [A, Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
  have hsquare (t : ℝ≥0) (z₀ : E × E) : (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * M ^ 2 := by
    have ha := (abs_le.mp (hAbound t z₀))
    have hb := (abs_le.mp (hbound z₀))
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A t z₀ - f z₀ - 2 * M),
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2 * M - (A t z₀ - f z₀) by linarith)
        (show 0 ≤ 2 * M + (A t z₀ - f z₀) by linarith)]
  have hsM (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (fun z₀ : E × E => (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2) :=
    ((hAM t).sub hf.measurable).pow_const 2
  have hsi (t : ℝ≥0) : Integrable (fun z₀ : E × E => (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2) (ν y) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hsM t).aestronglyMeasurable (4 * M ^ 2)
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z₀ => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (A t z₀ - f z₀))] using hsquare t z₀
  refine ⟨fun t => ⟨hAM t, hsi t, hsquare t⟩, ?_⟩
  have hlimit (z₀ : E × E) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => A t z₀) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)) :=
      (htest y xRef z₀ f hf M hM hbound).2
    have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ≥0 => f z₀) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [sub_self, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)] using
      (ht.sub hc).pow 2
  have hDCT := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (μ := ν y)
    (F := fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun z₀ : E × E => (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2)
    (f := fun _ : E × E => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ : E × E => 4 * M ^ 2)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => (hsM t).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z₀ => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (A t z₀ - f z₀))] using hsquare t z₀)
    (integrable_const _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hlimit)
  simpa only [integral_zero] using hDCT

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualOuterBoundedL2Continuity

candidate_publication_context.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. In addition, define the exact conditional position probability q_y=volume.tilted(x↦−V(x)−‖x−y‖²/(2η)) and the initial phase probability ν_y=q_y⊗N(0,I_E). Both probability normalizations are conclusions derived from the same six analytic hypotheses. For each fixed y,xRef, each continuous real f:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 with |f(z)|≤M for all z, define the actual clock expectation A_t f(z)=∫_Ω f(Z(y,xRef,z,t,sample))P(dsample). The same single existential actual phase Z is used for every test, bound and initial state. These outputs hold for every deterministic y and xRef without any phase-invariance premise. This is the bounded continuous real test subclass, an attributed ASTIS extension of the authors compactly supported continuous test ingredient in AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The same existential Z precedes every test f and every bound M. Tests are real-valued and continuous on the literal product phase; every M≥0 bounding |f| globally is quantified. This is an explicit ASTIS C_b elaboration of source C_c, not a new dynamics condition.

The integral is over the actual iid exponential clock law P for fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0. Boundedness gives integrability; no arbitrary law, probabilistic convergence, integral bound or expectation limit is a public premise.
